facts.text: I have had frustrating experiences with chatbots in the past.
I have had chatbot conversations that left me feeling frustrated and like my time was wasted.
I prefer a human touch for more complex issues with chatbots.
I have had some pretty successful interactions with chatbots.
I find talking to a person comforting compared with talking to a chatbot.
